title: Wildcards
description:
Match file names against patterns with `*` and `?`.

```
match("report.txt", "*.txt")    -> yes
match("Report.TXT", "*.txt")    -> yes (case-insensitive)
match("a.tar.gz", "*.gz")       -> yes
match("data1.csv", "data?.csv") -> yes
match("data10.csv", "data?.csv") -> no
```
hints: Keep indexes into both strings and the position of the last `*`; on a mismatch, go back to just after that star and let it eat one more character (the same method as project m05's folder search).
requirements: `*` matches any number of characters (including none), `?` exactly one.
Work in linear time with the "remember the last star" method, not recursion that can blow up.
stretch: Support several patterns separated by `;`, as file dialogs do.
